newsitem.title: USA: Richfood Holdings names Stokely CEO.
newsitem.headline: Richfood Holdings names Stokely CEO.

text.p: Richfood Holdings Inc said on Monday that Chairman Donald Bennett will hand over the job of chief executive to John Stokely, currently president and chief operating officer, effective January 1.
Bennett will remain the company's Chairman.
Bennett, 60, has served as Richfood's CEO since 1990, and as Chairman since 1993. Stokely joined Richfood in 1990 as chief financial officer prior to being named operating chief in 1994.

"The succession plan was designed to ensure continuity of the management philosophies that have created value for Richfood's shareholders and customers, and to maintain the leadership needed to reach our strategic objectives," Bennett said in a statement accompanying the announcement.
